full_prompt_en: Two large ravens face one another among layered trunks and dense foliage in a woodland saturated with crimson. The bird on the left is nearly black and seen in side profile, its long beak and folded wing drawn with closely nested grey lines. The bird on the right stands higher and more upright, its charcoal body covered in tiny scalloped feather marks and its pale ringed eye fixing a bright point in the composition. Coral-red branches weave overhead, while pale grey tree trunks interrupt the warm background at irregular intervals. Shrubs with cream, red, and dark leaves crowd the lower half, so the birds appear embedded in a rich tapestry rather than isolated against an empty field. Narrow horizontal bands of glowing red and white give the far background a strangely luminous depth. Every area carries pattern: bark has flowing striations, wings have repeated feather contours, and foliage breaks into small decorative sprays. Yet the strongest shapes remain simple and readable, with black avian silhouettes held against scarlet and off-white. The image feels like an intricate hand-pulled print or densely worked illustration, its lines precise and slightly textured rather than mechanically uniform. There is little naturalistic light modeling; contrast arises mainly from the disciplined separation of dark charcoal, warm red, and pale grey. A balanced pair of focal forms and a busy but controlled field of marks make the scene intense, ornamental, and quietly watchful.
full_prompt_zh: 两只硕大的渡鸦在一片被绯红色浸透的树林里隔着层叠树干和密集叶丛相对而立。左侧的鸟几乎全黑，以侧面出现，长喙和收起的翅膀由紧密套叠的灰线勾出。右侧的鸟站得更高、更直，炭灰色身体覆盖着细小的扇贝状羽纹，带浅色眼圈的眼睛成为画面中的一点亮色。珊瑚红枝条在上方交织，浅灰树干以不规则间隔切开温暖背景。奶油色、红色和深色叶片组成的灌木挤满下半部，使鸟仿佛嵌入华丽的织毯，而不是孤立在空白里。细窄的红白水平亮带赋予远景一种奇异的发光深度。每一处都带有纹样：树皮有流动条纹，翅膀有反复的羽毛轮廓，枝叶碎成小型装饰花簇。但最有力的形状依旧简明清晰，黑色鸟形稳稳立于猩红与灰白之间。画面像精细的手工版画或密集绘制的插画，线条准确且略带肌理，并非机械均匀。自然主义式的明暗塑造很少；对比主要来自炭黑、暖红和浅灰的严格分隔。一对均衡的焦点形体与繁密却受控的笔痕共同造就强烈、装饰性十足又悄然警觉的气氛。
style_prompt_en: An ornamental, densely patterned image language uses charcoal silhouettes against saturated crimson and pale ash grey. Repeated small contour marks fill major forms, while branching lines, layered sprays, and barklike striations cover the surrounding field. The shapes read first as strong flat masses and then reward closer viewing with fine nested textures. Color stays disciplined: warm scarlet and coral provide radiance, near-black establishes weight, and cool off-white separates crowded passages. Depth comes from overlap, irregular vertical intervals, and thin horizontal light bands more than from soft shading. Edges are precise but retain a subtly handmade grain. The overall surface feels like an intricate print or painted illustration, intense and decorative without losing compositional clarity.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性且纹样密集的画面语言，让炭黑剪影立于饱和的绯红与浅灰之间。反复的小轮廓纹填充主要形体，分叉的线条、层叠的小簇和树皮状条纹覆盖周围区域。形状先以有力的平面色块被识别，近看又显露细密的套叠纹理。配色严格：暖猩红与珊瑚红带来光感，近黑色提供分量，冷灰白分开拥挤区域。深度更多来自重叠、不规则的垂直间隔和细窄的水平亮带，而非柔和明暗。边缘准确，却保留细微手工颗粒。整体表面像精致的版画或绘制插画，浓烈而富装饰性，同时保持构图清晰。
theme_en: Two dark ravens in a crimson woodland
theme_zh: 绯红树林中的两只深色渡鸦
name: Annie Soudain
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
